::: handwriting
Mother,

I painted GO HOME TV on their van, and I am sorry, but at 21:15 that same evening I was on the train to Birmingham.

I am not sorry that I want them gone. That loud man films our workers as if they were a circus.

The interview went well. They liked my robot faces best. If the Hallworth's order goes well, Mother needs me to paint robot faces all through 1959, and art school must wait.

Your Anneliese
:::
